---
title: "Muliple ROC curves"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r,message=FALSE}
library(IRanges)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Generate a fake dataset
```{r}
# Generate random cell type labels (10 types, 100 cells in each type)
y_true <- sample(gl(10,100,labels = sprintf("Type_%.2d",1:10)))

# Generate a matrix of random prediction scores 
# 1000 cells by 10 classes
P <- matrix(runif(length(y_true)*nlevels(y_true)),length(y_true),nlevels(y_true),dimnames = list(NULL,levels(y_true)))
```




# Compute ROC curves
```{r}
# Convert the factor of labels into a binary matrix
Y <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(seq_along(y_true),y_true) |> 
  as.matrix()

roc_data <- lapply(seq_along(colnames(P)),function(i) {
  bmrm::roc.stat(P[,i],Y[,i])
}) 
names(roc_data) <- colnames(P)
```


# Display ROC curves
```{r}
roc_data |> 
  SplitDataFrameList() |> 
  stack() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  ggplot(aes(x=sensitivity,y=specificity,color=name)) + 
    geom_line() + 
    coord_equal() + 
    geom_abline(slope=-1,intercept=1) + 
    scale_x_continuous(label=scales::percent) + 
    scale_y_continuous(label=scales::percent) + 
    theme_bw()
```

# Get AUC values
```{r}
sapply(roc_data,attr,"AUC")
```
